title: Heartbroken Demon
description: A purple demon with large red horns, glowing red eyes, and tears streaming down its face stands in a dilapidated room covered in red hearts and love letters. It holds a glowing broken heart emitting red energy while surrounded by several glowing, bandaged ghost-like figures also emitting red light from their chests.
prompt: A sad purple demon with large curved red horns, glowing red eyes, and tears stands in a decaying room with torn wallpaper covered in red hearts and love notes. The demon holds a glowing broken heart with red energy and ribbons, surrounded by several translucent glowing ghost figures with bandages and red glowing hearts in their chests, dramatic red light rays from above, dark emotional atmosphere
